finding: The unchanged Permissions-Policy data-url test times out in both actual Chrome and native headless execution. Native stderr identifies missing document.permissionsPolicy.allowsFeature; no new policy bypass is established.
limitations: No passing security acceptance is inferred from matching timeouts.
Image loading and securitypolicyviolation/report delivery are outside the headless harness; those7 planned variants remain explicitly unrun.
New code covers child GET data form navigation and captured source policy; POST data navigation remains an explicit product limitation.
Other local schemes, non-form location/window.open initiator semantics, dynamic meta policy processing and originalPolicy reporting remain separate unverified work.
Current source-expression CSP binding is tested for canonical HTTP(S)/FTP origins and opaque denial; it is not a claim of complete CSP implementation.
requiredNextEnvironment: Use exact native Mac artifact with a separate pinned official WPT fixture; all selected files/variants unchanged; run Chrome control separately; retain every timeout/error and report unsupported browser API separately.
